invariant: r ≤ nums.length ∧ ∀ r', r' < r → ¬ (((List.range k).map (· + 1)).all (fun n => List.elem n ((nums.reverse).take r')) = true)
guard: r < nums.length ∧ ¬ (((List.range k).map (· + 1)).all (fun n => List.elem n ((nums.reverse).take r)) = true)

lemmas.name: exit52
lemmas.statement: ∀ (nums : List Nat) (k : Nat) (h : minOperations_precond nums k) (r : Nat), (r ≤ nums.length ∧ ∀ r', r' < r → ¬ (((List.range k).map (· + 1)).all (fun n => List.elem n ((nums.reverse).take r')) = true)) → ¬ (r < nums.length ∧ ¬ (((List.range k).map (· + 1)).all (fun n => List.elem n ((nums.reverse).take r)) = true)) → minOperations_postcond nums k r h
lemmas.proof:
by intro nums k h r hinv hg
  obtain ⟨hr, hmin⟩ := hinv
  have hcov : (((List.range k).map (· + 1)).all (fun n => List.elem n ((nums.reverse).take r)) = true) := by
    by_cases hlt : r < nums.length
    · by_contra hn; exact hg ⟨hlt, hn⟩
    · have hrl : r = nums.length := by omega
      subst hrl
      rw [List.all_eq_true]; intro n hn
      have hm : n ∈ nums := by have := List.all_eq_true.mp h n hn; simpa using this
      rw [List.take_of_length_le (by simp)]; simpa using hm
  unfold minOperations_postcond
  dsimp only
  refine ⟨hcov, ?_⟩
  by_cases hpos : r > 0
  · rw [if_pos hpos]; exact hmin (r - 1) (by omega)
  · rw [if_neg hpos]
    have hr0 : r = 0 := by omega
    subst hr0
    by_contra hk0
    have hk : k ≠ 0 := by simpa using hk0
    have h1 := List.all_eq_true.mp hcov 1 (List.mem_map.mpr ⟨0, List.mem_range.mpr (by omega), rfl⟩)
    simp at h1

lemmas.name: step52
lemmas.statement: ∀ (nums : List Nat) (k : Nat) (r : Nat), (r ≤ nums.length ∧ ∀ r', r' < r → ¬ (((List.range k).map (· + 1)).all (fun n => List.elem n ((nums.reverse).take r')) = true)) → (r < nums.length ∧ ¬ (((List.range k).map (· + 1)).all (fun n => List.elem n ((nums.reverse).take r)) = true)) → (r + 1 ≤ nums.length ∧ ∀ r', r' < r + 1 → ¬ (((List.range k).map (· + 1)).all (fun n => List.elem n ((nums.reverse).take r')) = true))
lemmas.proof:
by intro nums k r hinv hg
  obtain ⟨hr, hmin⟩ := hinv
  obtain ⟨hlt, hn⟩ := hg
  refine ⟨by omega, fun r' hr' => ?_⟩
  by_cases he : r' = r
  · subst he; exact hn
  · exact hmin r' (by omega)
